stem: A student says, 'The Constitution is sacred, so any talk of changing it is against democracy.' Which response best reflects the approach of the makers of the Indian Constitution?
options: It is sacred and so must never be changed
It is an ordinary law changeable by any majority
It is respected but may be changed when needed
It must be rewritten every ten to fifteen years
explanation: Correct option: (C). The makers placed the Constitution above ordinary law and expected respect for it, yet recognised it may need changes; it combines the 'sacred document' and 'instrument' views. Treating it as unchangeable, as an ordinary law, or as needing periodic rewriting each takes only one extreme.
